channel.title: All India: CAP Disaster Alert Feeds
channel.description: CAP Integrated Alert System Warning Updates

item.title: Thunder with lightning and Moderate to intense Rain is very likely to occur at a few places over Jhansi, Lalitpur in next 3 hours.
item.author: controlroom@ndma.gov.in (IMD Lucknow)

item.title: మీ ప్రాంతంలో పిడుగులు పడే అవకాశం ఉంది.ఉరుములు మెరుపులతో కూడిన వర్షం పడేప్పుడు చెట్లు,టవర్స్,పోల్స్,పొలాలు,బహిరంగ ప్రదేశాల్లో ఉండరాదు.సురక్షితమైన భవనాల్లో ఆశ్రయం పొందండి-ఆంధ్రప్రదేశ్ ప్రభుత్వం.
item.author: controlroom@ndma.gov.in (Andhra Pradesh SDMA)

item.title: Light to moderate Rain accompanied by light thunderstorm and lightning is very likely to occur at a few places over South Tripura in next 1-2 hours.
item.author: controlroom@ndma.gov.in (IMD Agartala)

item.title: Light Rain is very likely to occur at isolated places over Navsari, Tapi, The Dangs, Valsad, Dadra And Nagar Haveli, Daman in next 3 hours.

item.title: IMD Guwahati has issued forecast for Thunderstorm with Lightning and rain/thundershowers which is very likely to occur at many places over Charaideo, Dhemaji, Dibrugarh and Tinsukia in next 3 hours. Issued in Public Interest by ASDMA.
item.author: controlroom@ndma.gov.in (IMD Guwahati)
